scope: The original 123 left-out runs from the MK history review. Additional roster coverage is reported separately. No identity is inferred from a name alone.
criterion: Confirm only an election-specific source identifying the MK; rule out only positive contradictory evidence; otherwise unknown.

tzinker-2003.accessMethod: web search and opened source; retained local gazette for roster rank
tzinker-2003.note: 7 Jan 2003 interview: the 15th-Knesset MK describes founding Citizen and State and standing for the next Knesset.

dayan-2006.accessMethod: web search and opened source; retained local gazette for roster rank
dayan-2006.note: 2006 interview identifies Tafnit leader as Major-General Uzi Dayan; same public biography as the later MK.

toporovsky-2009.accessMethod: web search and opened source; retained local gazette for roster rank
toporovsky-2009.note: 11 Jan 2009 identifies Boaz Toporovsky as Tzabar leader and former student leader, the later MK.

corroboration.note: The MK biography explicitly records founding Tzabar in November 2008 and heading its unsuccessful 2009 list; connects the contemporary leader to the later MK. Not counted as independent corroboration.

cohen-2013.accessMethod: web search and opened source; retained local gazette for roster rank
cohen-2013.note: 22 Jan 2013 identifies Hatnua No. 9 as Jerusalem councillor Merav Cohen, with spouse and age, the later MK.

yachad-2015.accessMethod: web search and opened source; retained local gazette for roster rank
yachad-2015.note: 30 Jan 2015 describes submission of Eli Yishai and Yoni Chetboun’s Yachad list, Chetboun remaining at No. 2; identifies the incumbent politicians.

barak-2019.accessMethod: web search and opened source; retained local gazette for roster rank
barak-2019.note: Identifies Democratic Union as Meretz, Israel Democratic under Ehud Barak, and the Green Movement; former prime minister identity is explicit in contemporary N12 coverage.

amsalem-2021.accessMethod: web search and opened source; retained local gazette for roster rank
amsalem-2021.note: Am Shalem founded by Haim Amsalem, elected for Shas in 2009; stood again in 2021. Retained 2021 list names him first.

avidar-2022.accessMethod: web search and opened source; retained local gazette for roster rank
avidar-2022.note: 14 Sep 2022: Eli Avidar submits Israel Free Democratic’s list, with his CEC appearance photographed; same former MK.

hendel-wilf-2026.accessMethod: web search and opened source; retained local gazette for roster rank
hendel-wilf-2026.note: 7 Sep 2026 submission report names Hendel first, Zelekha second, Wilf third and explicitly describes Wilf’s earlier Knesset service. Later official retained list preserves these three places.

nino-2013.accessMethod: web search and opened source; retained local gazette for roster rank
nino-2013.note: Identifies incumbent MK Nino Abesadze as No. 19 on Labor’s 2013 list, connecting candidacy directly to service.

kahalani-2003.accessMethod: web search and opened source; retained local gazette for roster rank
kahalani-2003.note: Biography explicitly records Likud No. 41 in 2003 and refusal to enter in January 2006. Corroborating CEC capture held by IDI: https://www.idi.org.il/media/5993/הליכוד-16.pdf .

yellin-2019.accessMethod: web search and opened source; retained local gazette for roster rank
yellin-2019.note: Biography explicitly connects former Yesh Atid MK Haim Yellin to Labor No. 10 in April 2019; confirms no seat and subsequent retirement. N12 contemporaneous report was discovered but opening failed.

corroboration.note: 21 February 2019 report explicitly identifies the incumbent Yesh Atid MK as Labor’s reserved No. 10.

biton-death.accessMethod: web search and opened source; retained local gazette for roster rank
biton-death.note: MK biography records death in 2005, before this election. This excludes only the proposed MK identity.

yehuda-death.accessMethod: web search and opened source; retained local gazette for roster rank
yehuda-death.note: MK biography records death in 1985, before this election. This excludes only the proposed MK identity.

efrati-death.accessMethod: web search and opened source; retained local gazette for roster rank
efrati-death.note: MK biography records death in 1975, before this election. This excludes only the proposed MK identity.

levy-death.accessMethod: web search and opened source; retained local gazette for roster rank
levy-death.note: MK biography records death in 2024, before this election. This excludes only the proposed MK identity.

azoulay-death.accessMethod: web search and opened source; retained local gazette for roster rank
azoulay-death.note: MK biography records death in 2018, before this election. This excludes only the proposed MK identity.

hazan-death.accessMethod: web search and opened source; retained local gazette for roster rank
hazan-death.note: Authority identifies Yaakov Hazan as 1899–1992; cannot be the 2009 Shas candidate.

eitan-death.accessMethod: web search and opened source; retained local gazette for roster rank
eitan-death.note: MK biography explicitly records death on 23 Nov 2004, before the 2009 election; Ministry of Defence indexed biography corroborates this date.

same-election-id.accessMethod: web search and opened source; retained local gazette for roster rank
same-election-id.note: High-confidence ties to an already elected candidate in the same election; a candidate cannot stand twice. See the exact candidate id recorded per conclusion. Source rosters and membership ties are already retained in this repository.
